params.caption:
🎮 PS Plus Extra's final 4 games for November are live!

Sony has added the last batch of November 2026 PlayStation Plus Extra titles, now available to download in the UK, USA, and Japan:

🏏 Cricket 26: The Official Game of the Ashes (PS5)
🐉 Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii (PS5, PS4)
🏍️ MotoGP 26 (PS5)
🔫 Trepang2 (PS5)

🕒 Published: 1:00 PM GMT+3, Nov 24, 2026

📰 Sources: Push Square

👥 x.com/PlayStation

Which one are you downloading first? Drop a comment below 👇

#PlayStation #PSPlus #PS5 #PlayStationPlus #GamingNews
